MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.

3. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.

4. When practising Guided Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading.

5. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

6. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
7. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
